shared_elements: low relief carving on a flat stone surface
row of figures in a horizontal register
registers stacked one above another (A) / single register with border band (B)
figures/creatures with heads shown in profile
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief figures set out in horizontal rows/registers with profile heads, which is the only substantive correspondence, and it is a near-universal compositional device. The subject matter is otherwise entirely different: A depicts schematic animals (crouching quadrupeds/felines, a large bird or reptile head, a snake-like form) and abstract chevron/net patterns with no human presence, whereas B depicts a procession of naturalistically proportioned bearded human dignitaries in fluted headdresses and robes, walking, holding hands and carrying vessels and weapons.
